author: /root/r36_scientific_contract_preparation
trigger: Parent identified that the existing owner/RUN_CONTRACT preserves old one-use budgets but establishes no new R36-05 one-use cap. Parent reports no scientific producer has run; only source intake and code checks occurred.
finding: The preparer supplied the one-invocation, 180-second and 2-GiB figures without an inherited source-backed hard cap. Their original hard-limit wording was an unsupported resource-policy decision.
precedence: This clarification supersedes only the resource-cap and rerun consequences of execution_limits.numerical_subcap. All scenarios, seeds, draws, working error law, numerical tolerances, acceptance, scientific claim boundaries, and prohibitions on replaying old exhausted work remain frozen.

corrected_resource_policy.authority: The parent/controller supplies actual R36-05 execution limits. No new hard cap, one-use allowance, exhausted status, or replacement allocation is established by this preparation.
corrected_resource_policy.wall_time_seconds_180: SOFT_PERFORMANCE_TARGET only; exceeding this target alone is not scientific failure or exhaustion.
corrected_resource_policy.process_tree_rss_2_GiB: SOFT_PERFORMANCE_TARGET only; exceeding this target alone is not scientific failure or exhaustion.
corrected_resource_policy.one_producer_invocation: Preferred batching target, not a one-use cap or a prohibition on bounded implementation repair and verification.
corrected_resource_policy.threading: Retain BLAS/OMP/MKL threads=1 as the reproducibility/performance configuration.
corrected_resource_policy.execution_accounting: Retain first failures and record cumulative commands, elapsed time and available resource measurements across attempts under the same actual packet/task identity. Do not reset historical costs or old allowances.
corrected_resource_policy.bounded_repairs: A soft-target overrun or implementation defect may be reported and resolved through the existing parent-directed bounded coding/repair workflow. This preparation does not force refusal or invent a newly exhausted allowance. Scientific design changes still require scientific-owner interpretation before production.
corrected_resource_policy.existing_hard_limits: Any independently applicable actual controller or owner hard limit remains binding and must be cited from its real source; do not infer a new one from the superseded numerical_subcap text.

scope: Resource-policy clarification before outcomes; no scientific design change, production, PASS, or review decision.
independent_review: A future reviewer must be another agent; this author remains a preparation contributor to R36-05.
